title.narrative: Reducing Climate pollutants Recycling Compost led enterprises (RECYCLE)

description.narrative: The project will focus on establishing backward integration in the food systems and ensuring that the compost generated by women is used in the food production process. The geographic coverage of the project will be Budiriro and Glen View in Harare targeting smallholder women farmers who will benefit from climate smart agriculture that uses organic fertilizer generated by women recyclers. Black Soldier Fly technology will be integrated to project interventions and support both organic fertilizer production and small livestock production. The mission over time is for smallholder women farmers to move from chicken production supported by Black Soldier Fly technology to goats and ultimately dairy farming. A network of women recyclers connected to smallholder women farmers will be established and twinning arrangements between City of Harare's solid waste management division and rural local authorities' food security division will be facilitated. Beyond establishing backward integration, the intervention will also advance solid waste value addition by using pallets to produce plastic feeders and irrigation equipment for sale.
